definitions.explanation: The underlying support or foundation on which something is built or operates. Can be physical, economic, or abstract.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}の{基盤|きばん}を{強化|きょうか}する。
examples.english: We will strengthen the economic foundation.

examples.japanese: {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{基盤|きばん}を{築|きず}く。
ITインフラは{現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}の{基盤|きばん}だ。
examples.english: IT infrastructure is the foundation of modern society.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{社会|しゃかい}{基盤|きばん} (social infrastructure)
・{経済|けいざい}{基盤|きばん} (economic foundation)
・{産業|さんぎょう}{基盤|きばん} (industrial base)
・{支持|しじ}{基盤|きばん} (support base - political)
・{技術|ぎじゅつ}{基盤|きばん} (technological foundation)

PATTERNS:
・〜の{基盤|きばん}を{築|きず}く (to build a foundation for...)
・〜を{基盤|きばん}に (based on..., with... as a foundation)
・{基盤|きばん}を{固|かた}める (to solidify one's foundation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{基礎|きそ} (foundation, basis - more fundamental)
・{土台|どだい} (foundation - more physical)
・インフラ (infrastructure - loanword)
